asset.name: Chainlink

score_rationales.supply: LINK is hard-capped at 1B with no minting; CoinGecko-style snapshots show about 727M circulating (~72.7% of max), so most supply is already in the float, while roughly 273M remain non-circulating and Chainlink still routes periodic treasury releases (on-chain reporting cited transfers on the order of ~14M LINK in a single April 2025 quarterly event). Native Staking v0.2 caps participation at 45M LINK (~6.2% of that circulating supply) with a 28-day unstaking cooldown, locking meaningful liquidity for security. Glassnode labels roughly 143.5M LINK on exchanges (aggregated balances, sample point March 2026), which is a material but not majority share of circulation—consistent with continued self-custody and staking sinks versus pure CEX inventory.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: Broad oracle integrations and enterprise TVS.
score_rationales.value_capture: Daily revenue: $1.1M (~$417.2M/year). No TVL (oracle/infra model, scored on absolute revenue). Daily fees: $1.2M.

decision_trace.summary: Hold: leader-tier asset remains active, but no accumulation trigger is currently confirmed (no RSI capitulation and no active Wyckoff accumulation regime).
